_about: The per-system switch for assisted apply in the UAply phone app (docs/assisted-apply.md). mode 'assisted' (the default): UAply fills the employer's form and the person reviews it and taps Submit. mode 'automatic': UAply may press Submit itself, and the app honors it only when ALL of these hold: counsel_approved is true (the owner's lawyer read that system's terms and says agent submission is allowed: the lawyer flips this, not the code), human_check_share is 0 (none of the measured hosted forms had a human check), and the page in front of the person shows no human check of any kind at that moment, every required question is answered and the resume is attached. Measured October 21, 2026 on 20 real postings per system, on the owner's Galaxy (Chrome 138), nothing submitted.

greenhouse.human_check: Google reCAPTCHA, invisible (score based), on 20 of 20 hosted forms
greenhouse.terms: No candidate or website terms of use on greenhouse.com/legal; the Master Subscription Agreement binds employers only (4(c)(ix): no circumventing technological protective measures).

lever.human_check: hCaptcha, invisible until Lever asks, on 20 of 20 hosted forms
lever.terms: Lever (Employ Inc.) Terms of Service, last updated August 25, 2023, bind customers only; no candidate terms and no clause on automated means.

ashby.human_check: none seen on 20 of 20 hosted forms (no reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha or Turnstile loaded)
ashby.terms: Ashby Customer Terms of Service (September 29, 2025) bind customers only (5.1(f): no circumventing security features); no candidate terms.

smartrecruiters.human_check: see docs/assisted-apply.md: the hosted form is behind SmartRecruiters' bot protection
smartrecruiters.terms: Candidate Terms of Use (May 14, 2019) bind candidates: 'Use automatic means to access content or data from other users' is prohibited conduct.

workable.human_check: Cloudflare Turnstile, invisible, on 20 of 20 hosted forms
workable.terms: Workable Terms of Use (March 2, 2026) bind customers and their users (4.5.3, 4.5.4); no candidate terms of use found (workable.com/candidate-terms is a privacy notice template).
